messages:
Kim: quick heads-up — nightly metering replay detected a gap for multipart ingest on 2026-03-19 22:00-23:30 UTC. Looks like ~1.2M missing embed rows that didn't land in the metering pipeline. need finance OK to run a replay that will re-process and could increase billed tokens.
Ravi: can you share how you estimated the 1.2M and the expected cost? cc @Ava
Kim: left a short query we ran against the ingestion ledger: ```sql
SELECT count(*) as missing FROM ingestion_events
WHERE event_time BETWEEN '2026-03-19T22:00:00Z' AND '2026-03-19T23:30:00Z'
  AND status = 'dropped' AND source = 'multipart-proxy';
```
Kim: cost estimate: ~1.2M embeddings * 0.00012 $/embed ~= $144 (rounded). plus token overhead for retries ~+$30 => total ~~$174. rough ballpark.
Ava: two quick asks — 1) will this double-bill any customers? 2) can we run with an idempotency check to avoid duplicates?
Kim: good Q. re double-bill: the replay will include dedupe keys (request_id + chunk_hash) and our metering pipeline will check for existing acked rows before emitting billable events. I pasted the replay job flags: ```
--dedupe=true --dry-run=false --max-emit=inf --rate-limit=2000
```
Ravi: sounds reasonable. what's the runtime window and SLO for the replay? any risk to live production?
Kim: plan is to run tonight 02:00-04:00 UTC (low traffic). the job streams to the metering topic; ingestion throttled to keep latency unaffected. we've tested locally with a 10k sample.
Ava: will ops monitor and can we cap spend? i'd like a hard stop if cost > $250.
Kim: can do — will set `--budget-cents=25000` and job will auto-stop when reached.
Ravi: ok from finance side i approve up to $250 for the replay, provided dedupe is on and job auto-stops. :thumbsup:
Kim: thanks @Ravi — scheduling now. tagging the deploy bot to queue the job.
sre-deploy-bot: incoming replay job request queued by Kim. job_id=rp-20260323-0001. scheduled_start=2026-03-23T02:00:00Z. dedupe=true, budget_cents=25000.
Ava: please post post-run summary with counts: processed, emitted_billable, duplicates_skipped, cost_actual.
Kim: will do. ETA for summary ~within 2 hours after run end.
Ravi: approved. any customer comms needed?
Kim: no external comms planned; internal ticket created (FIN-4821) in case invoice adjustments required.
Ava: cool — :eyes: monitoring channel will watch.
Kim: thanks everyone. proceeding to run at 02:00 UTC with the limits above.
